import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int NN = 1 << 7;

    static int power(int a, int n) {
        long ans = 1;
        long base = a % MOD;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) ans;
    }

    static int[][] p = new int[NN][NN];
    static int[][] pro = new int[NN][NN];
    static int[] bpt = new int[NN];
    static long[][] q = new long[NN][NN];
    static int n;
    static int[] id = new int[NN];
    static List<Integer>[] vec = new ArrayList[NN];
    static Map<Pair, Integer> mp = new HashMap<>();

    static class Pair {
        int first;
        long second;
        Pair(int f, long s) { first = f; second = s; }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair p = (Pair) o;
            return first == p.first && second == p.second;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static int calc(int now, long st) {
        if (st == 0) return 0;
        if (now == n) return 1;
        Pair key = new Pair(now, st);
        if (mp.containsKey(key)) return mp.get(key);

        int ans = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j < (1 << n); j++) {
            long nst = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < vec[now].size(); k++) {
                if ((st & (1L << k)) == 0) continue;
                int cur = vec[now].get(k);
                int nxt = j - (j & cur);
                nst |= q[cur][nxt];
            }
            long add = (long) pro[now][j] * calc(now + 1, nst) % MOD;
            ans = (int) ((ans + add) % MOD);
        }
        mp.put(key, ans);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int r100 = power(100, MOD - 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = (int) ((long) sc.nextInt() * r100 % MOD);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                long prod = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if ((j & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                        prod = (prod * p[i][k]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prod = (prod * (MOD + 1 - p[i][k])) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                pro[i][j] = (int) prod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            bpt[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < NN; i++) {
            vec[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            vec[bpt[i]].add(i);
            id[i] = vec[bpt[i]].size() - 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ((i & (1 << j)) == 0) {
                    q[i][1 << j] = 1L << id[i | (1 << j)];
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                int low = j & -j;
                q[i][j] = q[i][low] | q[i][j ^ low];
            }
        }

        System.out.println(calc(0, 1));
    }
}
